fee_notes: Royalty is tiered and paid in two parts: (1) Minimum Royalty Fee ranging from $0 to $1,400/month based on months of operation (Table 1), and (2) Reconciled Royalty Fee based on prior calendar year Gross Revenue — royalty percentage ranges from 6% (>$2M GR) to 10% (<=$250K GR or opening year). NAF Contribution is the greater of $200/month or 2% of monthly Gross Revenue; franchisor may increase NAF by up to 10% per 12-month period. Local Marketing requirement is $1,000/month on average (not paid to franchisor unless franchisee fails to spend). Local Marketing Cooperative Contribution capped at $1,000/month, determined by majority vote. Software Access Fee is $132/month (increasing to $145 in October 2026). Pass-Thru Software Access Fees currently $146.43/month for third-party software (email, security, social media, LMS, etc.). Additional Training Fee currently $50/hour (up to $200/hour). Late charge is 1.5%/month on unpaid balances or highest legal rate, whichever is less; $25 insufficient funds fee.
